why: Each figure is the same right-angled triangle with a small step in its long slanted side, near the sharpest corner. Going clockwise from the right angle, options 2, 3 and 5 meet the short side first, but option 4 meets the sharp point first, so it is a mirror image. The book gives option 4.
trick: Start at the right angle and go clockwise: does the short side or the long side come first? The mirror image has the other order.
note: Book key says 4. My check finds option 1 is ALSO a mirror image (options 1 and 4 match each other; 2, 3, 5 match each other), so the question seems to have two odd figures; book answer kept. Figure 5's bottom edge has a small gap in the scan (print flaw), drawn closed.
